en: Vintage postcard with sepia photographs of a lake and surrounding forested landscape. One photo shows reeds and calm water with a small boat carrying two people; another shows a wider panoramic view of lakes and wooded islands. The card is heavily covered with handwritten black ink signatures and notes. Printed captions in red and vertical publisher information appear on the left and top edges.
